callgrind_scope: Full separate process invocation, including startup, file I/O, setup, warmup, checksum and untimed parse-result rasterization; Ir is NOT a stage-only counter. Wall-time samples above run without Valgrind.

comparison.checksum_note: FNV-1a over every premultiplied RGBA byte. Numerical rasterization differences are allowed; equality is not a pixel-conformance verdict.
comparison.ratio_definition: silk/rust native median stage time; >1 means silk slower

config.pixmap_policy: fresh zeroed allocation per render, included in stage time
config.sample_unit: one complete workload pass; sum per-file native times / iterations
config.timer: native monotonic wall clock; Python perf_counter_ns separately records process wall time

stages.end-to-end: Parse + record (Silk) / usvg retained tree + allocate/zero + render + intermediate-tree destruction. File I/O, PNG encoding, checksum and destination destruction excluded.
stages.parse: XML + computed style + geometry resolve + Silk record / usvg render-ready retained tree; not raw resolve. Retained result rasterized and consumed outside timing.
stages.render: Reuse retained display list/tree; allocate and zero a fresh destination inside every timed render; checksum and destination destruction outside timing.

spec.modifications: Original downloaded verbatim into tiger.svg; benchmark uses separately derived tiger-sized.svg with explicit root width and height. Geometry, paint and viewBox preserved; XML serialization may change namespace prefixes.

viewport_normalization.reason: Both engines receive the same explicit 900x900 host viewport rather than their different defaults for a viewBox-only SVG.
